title: Airshipcraft
description: Modpack for the official airshipcraft server.
body:
This is the modpack for the airshipcraft server. 
While it is not required to join the server, it is recomended. 
The main additions will be server tutorials and movecraft requirements. 
It also includes just about all the main optimization mods and some QoL mods. 

it is entirely client sided.

There is no ETA on the server. This pack is currently for development purposes only. 
Future players can and should download if they want sneakpeaks.
